name: const-doc-budgets
description: A character ceiling per group of documents, measured after every write and in a scan: each ceiling names its documents by path patterns, its number and the days of data it was set from, and warns until 30 days of data stand behind it; a history report over git gives those data; a document that must stand over its ceiling is declared as a departure in the dials file. Plus a skill for setting a ceiling and reading a finding.
